sources.by_version: R5 (.53): rules that change with a game version - a block applies from its 'since' version on (compared as numbers, oldest first); '_status' ASSUMED = values from a playtest, named in the report until confirmed by the live patch notes

'n-1' (default) plays header - 1, 'n' the header as is (the FoA values)
